description: Unit tests for DnsConfigService in the net/dns module, testing configuration reading, invalidation, and host parsing behaviors.

classes.name: DnsConfigServiceTest
classes.description: Test fixture for testing DnsConfigService behaviors, including configuration updates, invalidation, and host parsing.

classes.name: MockHostsParserFactory
classes.description: Mock class for DnsHostsParser to simulate host parsing behavior in tests.

methods.name: OnConfigChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when DNS configuration changes.

methods.name: WaitForConfig
methods.description: Waits until a DNS config notification is received.

methods.name: WaitForInvalidationTimeout
methods.description: Waits for the invalidation timeout to trigger config invalidation.

methods.name: ValidateNoNotification
methods.description: Ensures no configuration notification occurs during the wait period.

methods.name: MakeConfig
methods.description: Creates a DnsConfig object with a specified seed for testing.

methods.name: MakeHosts
methods.description: Creates a DnsHosts object with entries based on a seed.

methods.name: SetUpService
methods.description: Initializes the DNS config service and sets up config change watching.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment and initializes the DNS config service.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up after tests, ensuring no pending notifications.

methods.name: GetFactory
methods.description: Returns a factory for creating host parsers, used in mocking.

methods.name: CreateHostsEntry
methods.description: Creates a host entry with a name, address family, and IP address.
